notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: MG1655_WT is wild_type; the plasmid backbone strain stays reference. | Reviewed 2026-11-15: landing-pads strain is a control (user decision) | Medium, culture and construct details from the NAND-circuit preprint (doi:10.1101/2023.06.29.547078), which deposits its data as GSE206047: M9 salts + 0.2% casamino acids + 0.4% glucose, 96-well plates, 37 C, 1000 rpm, timepoints are hours post-induction. Strain names are given without the MG1655_ prefix. The landing-pads strain (four constitutively expressed heterologous genes and landing pads, per the preprint) expresses tetR, lacI, araC, luxR (heterologous_expression; is_control left open pending the user's call); pBADmin/pTACmin add a yfp reporter. | Paper: Garcia et al. 2022, Synthetic Biology 7(1):ysac012 (PMID 36035514, PMC9408027) describes 5 h / 8 h / 18 h as log phase / transition / stationary; 8 h set to transition. The paper does not name the medium. | User decision 2026-11-15: 18 h samples are stationary and 5 h samples exponential (inferred from the timepoint); 6.5 h and 8 h stay without a phase. | Reviewed 2026-11-15: labels from the submitters' GEO supplementary sheet GSE206047_metadata.csv.gz (fields sup:*; every sample matched by its sample.ginkgo id). Wild type, empty landing pads and the pJS007 backbone are reference genotype and controls (induced or not, per the control rule); the IcaR/PhlF plasmids, gates and NAND circuit are heterologous expression. pBADmin and pTACmin are left without genotype/control: the sheet does not say what they carry. Medium is not given anywhere; growth_phase left out (timepoints 5-18 h have no stated reference, no OD). | Ginkgo inducer screen, 1077 E. coli MG1655 samples. Per-sample text is only an opaque title and a timepoint (5, 6.5, 8, 18 h); which samples are induced, which inducer, the medium, culture mode and genotype are not given, so inducer_added, treatment, is_control, genotype_class and medium labels are left out. growth_phase left out: the timepoint reference (inoculation or induction) and the medium are unknown. molecule says polyA RNA but the protocol is KAPA rRNA depletion of total RNA -> total_rnaseq, depletion.
